testo:
■ Super Infinite Omega Evolution: Put this creature on one or more of your Guardian creatures from the battle zone, your graveyard and/or mana zone.
Triple Breaker
Eternal Omega
■ Meteorburn: Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a card under this creature into your graveyard. If you do, choose one of your opponent's creatures. Your opponent puts that creature into their deck and shuffles it.
■ While this creature is tapped, your opponent's creatures can't attack.
